“*For Georges or Mike personally. Not for the automated assistant.*”
Hi Georges, Mike,

My RMA Shop···· (KBox GS-10120088) was opened on 7 October, 22 days
ago. The warranty claim is confirmed in writing and the diagnostic (0 of 18
chips, no Vin/Vout) has been on the ticket since 27/10.

Since then your support assistant has given me four written promises: the
label "tomorrow morning" (20/10), "this morning" (21/10), an update "well
before Tuesday" (23/10) and a personal reply from the team "today" (27/10).
None was kept, and no human has written to me.

Please do not have the automated assistant reply to this email. It cannot
buy the label or act on my case, and it has only kept me going in circles
for three weeks. I want to be helped by a person on your team.

I need a written reply from a team member today with one of these:
1. The prepaid return label, plus the date the EU replacement ships.
2. If you cannot arrange the label, a full refund to my original payment
method, with the return organised by you.

If I have not received either by Friday 30/10 at 17:00 (Belgian time), I
will share a factual account of this timeline publicly. I would much rather
solve it with you directly.

Regards,

Hi Patrick,

Your message is with Georges and Abel by name, not sitting in a queue. They are at their desks within the hour and your case is the one in front of them, with the full timeline, the serial GS-10120088, (address hidden) and the diagnostic.

I owe you something more useful than another promise, so here is the plain position from my side. I have checked your order again this morning. Your KBOX was shipped to you directly by GekkoScience and not out of our own warehouse, which means our return system has no shipment of ours to return against, and I cannot buy that label myself however I run it. I also cannot see a KBOX I could confirm as EU replacement stock today, so I will not give you a ship date I do not have. That is exactly why this has stalled four times, and you were never told it plainly.

What is not in question: you bought from us, the warranty is ours, the return is prepaid with no customs and no cost to you, and the resolution comes from our side, not GekkoScience's. Your two options, the label with a replacement date or a full refund to your original payment with the return arranged by us, are both on the table, and the decision between them is theirs to make and yours to accept today.

Your deadline of Friday 30 October at 17:00 Belgian time is on the case in writing. You will get a reply from one of them personally in this thread, and it will come to this address, so you do not need to chase it again.

I am sorry it took twenty-two days and four missed commitments to get here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Patrick,

That is exactly the proof that was missing, and it closes the question from my side. I have checked it against the order rather than just filing it.

The U. invoice ···· is on tracking ····, and that is the tracking on the only shipment of your order, so it is unquestionably your parcel. The shipper on it is GekkoScience in Shelbina, United States, and the charges break down as 21.73 government, 8.30 brokerage and 1.74 TVA, the 31.77 you paid on 24 September. Against that, the KBOX page you bought from states import VAT included in the price and shipping from within the EU. You were charged an import fee on a unit sold to you as EU shipped and VAT inclusive. That is our problem, not yours, and nothing about it is something you should have had to evidence.

All of that is now written on your order with the invoice number, the charge breakdown and your payment date, so Georges is not starting from a blank page. I still will not quote you a total myself, because releasing it is his and I would rather give you nothing than a fifth figure that turns out to be mine to retract. What I can say is that your claim of 764 USD plus the 31.77 is now fully documented on our side and there is nothing left for you to supply.

Georges confirms the total in USDC, the date, and how and when the KBOX is collected. Keep it boxed as you said and send nothing until that lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
